title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00052 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling

RIH from 821m to 900m on DP. Filled string. Up/down weights 106t/100t. RIH to 918. 9m

Pulled up to 170t on hook load ton overpull) in order to engage spear inside 10 3/4in CSG and put casing in tension started cutting casing 1700l/min 92 bar, 1800l/min 97 bar, 1900l/min 101 bar, 2000l/min 104 bar. Pulled up to 187t on hook load overpull). Increased to 2200l/min 124 bar. Casing cut at 915. 2m
Pulled up through 10 3/4 hanger with 10 3/4in casing, OK to pass. RIH back, released spear from 10 3/4in casing fish

Pulled free of fish, hung up with grapple at 139. 4m through hanger. Troubleshoot to get through. Attempted to pull with MAX 10 ton overpull no success. Pulled up slowly and rotate to the right no success. Tried to rotate to the left and pull no success. Pulled and pumped with 200l/min 4 bar, pressure increased to 30bar when took weight at 139. 4m. RIH and engaged spear inside 10 3/4in CSG, pulled same through the hanger OK. Rotated it 4. 5 turns to the left torq) to reposition casing fish inside the well. Landed fish in the well and released spear. Attempted to pull spear through hanger no success. Pulled up total of 3,4m from top of CSG stump at 141. 9m

Evaluated situation. Discussed w/ onshore organisation. Meanwhile manufacturing c-plate to be able to hang off weight of the inner string decided way forward pull CSG fish on spear release spear from fish instal string stab above spear engage spear on surface, RIH fish on spear release spear, POOH
Performed pre-job meeting to pull out fish on spear to surface

Engaged spear to fish. POOH fish slowly. Top of fish hang up in hanger area. Rotated string 180 deg left, pulled up. Went through when POOH observed overpull spikes on weight indicator several times. MAX spike value of 40t
R/b 1x stand of DC, l/d bumper sub and string stab
